Send Cash Transfer To Beneficiary.description: Sends a mobile money payment to a programme beneficiary.

Pay Health Worker Stipend With Callback.description: Pays a stipend and asks Beyonic to notify a callback URL when it settles.

Register Contact.description: Creates a contact so they can be paid or asked to pay later.

Request Mobile Money Collection.description: Asks a customer to pay a set amount from their mobile money account.
